cues.codos: Elbows high: the bar rests on your shoulders, not your wrists.
cues.pie: The bar goes down and up over mid-foot.
cues.tronco: Chest up and torso upright the whole way.
cues.seguros: Set the rack safeties below your lowest point.

errores.codosCaen: Letting your elbows drop on the way up.

cues.pecho: Kettlebell held close to your chest, chest up.
cues.codos: Elbows pointing down, inside your knees.
cues.talones: Heels down; squat as deep as you can with a straight back.

errores.separar: Letting the kettlebell drift away from your chest.
errores.lumbar: Rounding your lower back at the bottom.
errores.rodillasDentro: Letting your knees cave in on the way up.

cues.espalda: Back and glutes against the backrest the whole way.
cues.rodillas: Knees in line with your feet, not caving in.
cues.profundidad: Lower to about 90° without your hips lifting off.
cues.seguros: Release and engage the safeties with your legs almost straight.

errores.bloquear: Snapping your knees into lockout at the top.
errores.despegar: Letting your lower back lift off by going too deep.
errores.talones: Pushing through your toes and lifting your heels.

cues.vertical: Lower straight down, weight on your front foot.
cues.pie: Front foot flat; your knee tracks over your toes.
cues.atras: Your back foot only rests: don't push with it.

errores.cerca: Placing your front foot too close to the bench.
errores.rodilla: Letting your front knee cave in.

cues.paso: Take a long, controlled step back onto the ball of your foot.
cues.peso: Weight on your front foot; push through it to stand.
cues.tronco: Torso upright, dumbbells hanging at your sides.

errores.corto: Stepping so short that your front knee shoots far forward.
errores.rodilla: Slamming your back knee into the floor.

cues.cadera: Push your hips back with knees only slightly bent.
cues.barra: The bar slides down your legs, over mid-foot.
cues.espalda: Neutral back: stop when you can't go lower without rounding.
cues.rango: Lower until you feel your hamstrings, about below the knee.

errores.redondear: Rounding your back to go lower.
errores.sentadilla: Bending your knees a lot and turning it into a squat.
errores.separar: Letting the bar drift away from your legs.

cues.apoyo: Rest the bottom of your shoulder blades on the bench.
cues.arriba: At the top, torso and thighs in line, glutes squeezed.
cues.barbilla: Chin tucked: eyes toward your knees.
cues.talones: Drive through your heels; shins vertical at the top.

errores.lumbar: Arching your lower back instead of extending your hips.
errores.pies: Placing your feet so far out that your hamstrings take over.

cues.eje: Line up your knee with the machine's pivot.
cues.arriba: Extend until almost locked and squeeze for a second.
cues.bajada: Lower slowly, don't let the weight drop.

errores.impulso: Swinging the weight up and dropping it at the bottom.
errores.cadera: Lifting your hips off the seat.

cues.cadera: Hips pressed into the bench the whole way.
cues.eje: Knees just off the bench, lined up with the pivot.
cues.bajada: Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.

errores.cadera: Lifting your hips to move more weight.

cues.rango: Drop your heel below the step and rise onto your toes.
cues.pausa: Hold for a second at the top and a second at the bottom.
cues.rodillas: Knees straight but not locked; move as one unit.

cues.rango: Lower your heel as far as you can and rise onto your toes.
cues.pausa: Hold for a second at the top.
cues.peso: Dumbbell on your knee, without pushing it with your hands.

errores.manos: Helping by pushing with your arms.

cues.pie: Whole foot on a sturdy box that won't move.
cues.empuje: Step up by driving through the leg on the box, not the back one.
cues.bajada: Lower slowly until your back toes touch down.

errores.impulso: Pushing off with your back leg.
errores.rodilla: Letting your working knee cave in.

cues.cadera: It's a hinge: hips back, then snap them forward.
cues.brazos: Arms straight and relaxed: they only guide the kettlebell.
cues.bloqueo: At the top, stand tall with glutes and abs squeezed.

errores.sentadilla: Squatting down instead of pushing your hips back.
errores.brazos: Lifting the kettlebell with your shoulders.
errores.lumbar: Rounding your back at the bottom or arching it at the top.

cues.cadera: Push your hips back with knees only slightly bent.
cues.pegadas: The dumbbells slide down close to your legs.

errores.redondear: Rounding your back to go lower.
errores.lejos: Letting the dumbbells drift away from your body.

cues.linea: Torso and back leg in line, like a seesaw.
cues.cadera: Hips level: don't let them open to the side.
cues.apoyo: Soft standing knee; if you lose balance, tap down with your toes.

errores.abrir: Rotating your hips and opening your back leg.
errores.redondear: Rounding your back to go lower.

cues.cadera: Push your hips back with soft knees.
cues.espalda: Neutral back: your torso lowers as one piece.
cues.carga: Start light and unrack it with the safeties set.

errores.redondear: Rounding your back to go lower.
errores.rodillas: Bending your knees a lot and turning it into a squat.

cues.espalda: Back against the backrest, hips still.
cues.abrir: Push your knees out as far as you control, no swinging.
cues.cerrar: Close slowly, without letting the weight stack slam.

errores.inclinar: Leaning forward to move more weight.
errores.golpe: Letting the weight slam as you close.

cues.talones: Heels on the floor the whole way.
cues.cadera: Sit your hips back and down, chest up.
cues.rodillas: Knees in line with your toes.

errores.rodillasDentro: Letting your knees cave in on the way up.

cues.atras: Sit back, as if reaching for a chair with your glutes.
cues.tocar: Touch the box without dropping or losing tension.
cues.subir: Stand by pushing the floor away, without rocking.

errores.rodillas: Letting your knees cave in on the way up.

cues.vertical: Lower straight down, like an elevator.
cues.rodilla: Front knee over your ankle; back knee almost touches the floor.
cues.empuje: Stand by pushing through your front foot.

errores.corta: Placing your feet too close together.

cues.talones: Feet close to your glutes; drive through your heels.
cues.arriba: Rise until shoulders, hips and knees are in line.
cues.lumbar: Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching your lower back.

errores.arquear: Arching your back to go higher.
errores.rapido: Going up and down without control.

cues.nivel: Hips level: don't let them drop toward the free side.
cues.arriba: At the top, torso and working thigh in line.

errores.girar: Letting your hips rotate or drop.

cues.espalda: Flat back and braced abs: only your leg moves.
cues.talon: Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling.
cues.rodilla: Knee bent at 90° the whole way.

errores.arquear: Arching your lower back to lift higher.
errores.girar: Rotating your hips toward the working leg.

cues.recta: Top leg straight, slightly behind your body line.
cues.punta: Toes point forward, not at the ceiling.
cues.lento: Lift to about 40° and lower slowly.

errores.girar: Rotating your hips and lifting with toes toward the ceiling.
errores.alto: Lifting too high and bending your torso.

cues.linea: Body straight from knees to head, without bending at the hips.
cues.lento: Lower as slowly as you can.
cues.manos: Use your hands to catch yourself and help you back up.

errores.cadera: Bending at the hips so your hamstrings work less.
errores.caer: Dropping at the end without braking.

cues.talon: Heel down; lift only the front of your foot.
cues.arriba: Lift as high as you can and hold for a second.

errores.rapido: Doing it fast and with no range.
errores.talon: Lifting your heel off the floor.

cues.tronco: Hold the tower, torso slightly leaning and still.
cues.atras: Drive your leg back with your glute, knee almost straight.
cues.lumbar: Stop before your lower back arches.

errores.arquear: Arching your back to lift your leg higher.

cues.pelvis: Pelvis level: don't lean toward your standing side.
cues.punta: Move your straight leg out with your toes pointing forward.
cues.vuelta: Return slowly without letting the band pull your knees together.

errores.inclinar: Leaning your torso to open further.
